Expressive plain paperbag visual language.

launchpad_flow.draft_status: REMOVED completely as requested. No drafts or staging state.
launchpad_flow.new_flow_description: Wallet Mockup Connection -> Enter Token Metadata & Bag Art -> Direct Deploy Action -> Instant Persistence & Live Token Trading Page Redirect

steps.title: Connect Wallet (Mockup)
steps.action: Simulate Phantom / Solflare wallet connection with 1-click modal. Displays fake address (e.g. 7xKP...9qL2) and balance (14.85 SOL).

steps.title: Token Paper Specification
steps.action: Input Name, Symbol, Description, Telegram, Twitter, Website, Initial Buy SOL amount, and Plain Paperbag artwork selection/upload.

steps.title: Deploy & Launch Token
steps.action: Click 'Deploy Token Now'. Executes mock bonding curve deployment, immediately saves token to MongoDB/backend, fires toast notification, and navigates immediately to /token/:id.

asset_prompts_and_svgs.hero_background_scenery: Hand-drawn 2D paper sketch art scene of a paper factory landscape with conveyor belts, paper bags moving, sketch clouds, tape strips, and blueprint grid guidelines in charcoal ink and warm beige tones.
asset_prompts_and_svgs.plain_paperbag_art: Simple 2D hand-drawn brown kraft paper bag doodle with folded top handles, raw sketch lines, zero face features, zero logos, crisp paper texture.
asset_prompts_and_svgs.bag_worker_machinery: Hand-drawn sketch illustration of a paper press machine processing kraft paper bags with gears, ink stamps, and measurement gauges.
asset_prompts_and_svgs.global_vault_art: Hand-drawn sketch illustration of four heavy paper-vault safes tied with rope and sealed with wax stamps.

testing_and_data_testid_requirements.rules: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, trade actions, modals) MUST have unique kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace 'Meet Bag Worker' headline with 'Every Token Has a Bag Worker' across all relevant components (Hero, BagWorkerPage, HomeEcosystem, PRD copy).

2. Remove all draft logic and draft storage from /launch flow. Replace it with a streamlined wallet mockup connection modal + token detail form + Instant 'Deploy Token' action that immediately persists the token in MongoDB and redirects to /token/:id.

3. Apply a cohesive 2D hand-drawn paper art & sketch/doodle aesthetic throughout all sections: ink outlines (border-2 border-[#1e1b18]), offset box shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_#1e1b18]), paper texture background (#f4efe4), handwritten annotations (Caveat font with slight rotation), tape & staple decorative accents, and specimen ledger cards.
4. Ensure ALL paperbag images and SVG icons are strictly PLAIN kraft paper bags with NO faces or printing.
5. Keep Bag Worker (/bag-worker) and Global Bag (/global-bag) as separate independent pages, while explaining both clearly on the Home page (/)
6. Maintain full functional completeness: trading chart, virtual buy/sell simulation, holder list, activity feeds, bag progress metrics, search/filtering/sorting on /bags, and leaderboard.
7. Ensure every interactive element retains or receives a data-testid attribute.
8. Perform responsive layout adjustments so all components look clean and structured on both mobile (390px) and desktop (1920px) screens.
